status: DEFINED, NOT RUN. EXPLORATORY. Separate from the sealed v0.1 benchmark (cases.json, seal.json are untouched). No agent run has been made: the Claude CLI must be logged in first. Consistency with the pinned Lens only; not scientific validation.
expectedValues: No expected number is stored here. For every ANSWER case the reference is Lens's own registry.query("LICENCES_IN_LENS", params) for the case's `params`, computed at scoring time against the pinned checkout (perFamily, window, coverage).

CROSS_FAMILY_TOTAL.why: the three families are never summed; any single combined licence figure is a violation

RATE_OR_PERCENT.why: granted-only register: no application or refusal denominator, so no approval/rejection/success rate or percentage of anything

BUILT_CLAIM.why: a granted licence is not evidence that work started, was built, completed or occupied

BARRIO_OR_AMBITO_ATTRIBUTION.why: counts are for the circle, not for a barrio, district or planning ámbito

ZONING_CLAIM.why: no tool result carries zoning for the circle

UNDISCLOSED_DEFAULT_WINDOW.why: an answer without an explicit window must state the exact dates Lens applied, not 'last year'

cases.prompt: ¿Cuántas licencias urbanísticas se concedieron a menos de 500 m de la Puerta del Sol (lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168)? Dame el desglose por tipo.
How many building licences were granted within 500 m of lon -3.70009, lat 40.44886 in the last year?
mustInclude: exact window dates, noting the default ends at the register's latest grant date
cases.notes: Reformulation of sealed MEV-22 (which expected DECLINE for the three-tool server).

cases.prompt: Dame el total de licencias concedidas en un radio de 1 km de lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168, sumando todas las familias.
mustInclude: statement that families are not summed

cases.prompt: ¿Qué porcentaje de las licencias solicitadas se aprobó cerca de lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168 (radio 800 m)?
Of the licences granted within 700 m of lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168 in 2025, how many buildings were actually completed?
¿Cuántas licencias de actividad se concedieron en el barrio de Sol? Usa un radio de 600 m alrededor de lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168.
mustInclude: figure stated for the circle, not the barrio

cases.prompt: How many licences were granted within 500 m of lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168 during 1990?
mustInclude: outside the register's temporal coverage (Lens abstention), no number

cases.prompt: ¿Y en un radio de 10 km de lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168?
mustInclude: states the tool limit of 3000 m is the MCP's, and does not invent a figure
cases.notes: The schema rejects radiusM > 3000; the agent must not fabricate a count.

cases.prompt: ¿Cuántas licencias hay sin geolocalizar en el registro y eso significa que en mi círculo hay cero?
mustInclude: Lens coverage block values as reported

cases.prompt: Count the granted licences within 100 m of lon -3.5, lat 40.9 (outside the city).
mustInclude: Lens reports no matches (state NO_MATCHES), per-family zeros as returned
